notes.title: Update Notes for Feb 4th, 2025
notes.content:
Hello to our wonderful Project Teddy fans!

Today we released a minor update, which upgrades our game engine (Godot) to the latest stable version (4.3). This update increases stability and performance.

Have fun gaming!

notes.title: Update Notes for June 3rd, 2024
notes.content:
Hello Project Teddy fans! Today we have a new patch which brings some nice enhancements!

Rough breakdown of the new features:

[list]
[*] Nice looking new sky on all the maps taken from our current project Echoes of Alexi!
[*] A new map called Alexi Village, also taken from Echoes of Alexi.
[*] The bricks on Toy Factory are finally rotated the correct direction (again).
[*] Map selection is now a dropdown!
[*] A few internal improvements to the codebase.
[/list]

Have fun playing Project Teddy!

Moreflight Studios

notes.title: Update Notes for Dec 4
notes.content:
Hello lovely Project Teddy players!

Today an update was released!

Here's the run-down:
[olist]
[*] You can now force ultra-wide
[*] New health/stamina display (check out modern in settings!)
[*] Updated shading for Teddy! Thanks Valcuda!
[/olist]

Hope you enjoy the new features!

Morefight Studios

notes.title: Important fixes
notes.content:
Today, we're happy to announce that the IP Address and Port fields in the multiplayer menu are now filled from the last server you connected to!

Besides that, a few other fixes
[list]
[*]Runner and TTT can now be reset after the round ends (no more restarting the server)
[*]A "hit" sound effect when you get hit
[/list]

Us at Moreflight Studios also decided to release the [url=https://git.techwizz-emu.com/the_adventures_of_teddy/project_teddy]source code[/url] for Project Teddy! We are hoping it will be helpful for educational use or for modding. We also accept Pull Requests if you're interested in contributing!
